title: Replay settles by ID in any state when some transitions are not logged
description: When deliveries are not logged, a replayed or replicated message is still ready when its ACK arrives. Restore published messages exactly (original ID and all fields, via a persisted record type if the API serde form drops one), apply replayed ACK/NACK by ID on ready or pending messages, record bulk removals (purge) by the IDs they removed, tolerate only not-found on replay, and record unlogged background transitions that change metadata (ACK-deadline requeues) as the equivalent operation (NACK) under the ordering stripe.
whenToUse: Logs or replication streams that skip some transitions while later records address entities by identity.
whenNotToUse: Logs that record every transition, or key-addressed state where re-applying the value suffices.
